Privacy & terms.

How this version of the website handles your choices and project enquiries.

Your selection

Favorite products are stored in your browser’s local storage on this device. They are not an account or a shared customer record. Remove individual favorites in My selection or clear this site’s browser data to erase them.

Contact

The enquiry form prepares an email draft. You review and send it through your email service. This site does not submit that form to a customer database.

Files and embedded media

Technical documents may be delivered from the manufacturer’s file service through this domain. Product videos and external modeling services use their own providers. Loading them can disclose network information, such as your IP address, to those providers. Hosting also involves the technical processing needed to deliver this site.

Product information

Photography, names and design credits remain the property of their respective owners. This is a digital experience concept. Confirm availability, materials and specifications before purchase. The Room Studio contains approximate design studies, not manufacturer CAD files.

Questions

For product enquiries, use the contact page. For privacy questions about your email service or browser, consult that provider’s controls.
